lead.headline: Institutional Convergence on Prediction Markets
lead.tldr: The simultaneous entry of Charles Schwab into prediction markets and Kalshi's IPO preparations signal a shift from niche crypto-native betting to mainstream financial instrument adoption.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief examines the institutionalization of prediction markets and the ongoing fee war in the ETF landscape.

top_signals.title: Charles Schwab to enter prediction markets with S&P 500 wagers: WSJ13m
top_signals.summary: Financial giant Charles Schwab is reportedly planning to enter the prediction markets space by offering wagers on the S&P 500. This move signals a growing institutional interest in the mechanisms of prediction markets, which are heavily utilized in the Web3 ecosystem.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Schwab's entry validates the prediction market model as a legitimate financial tool for hedging and speculation, bridging the gap between TradFi and Web3 mechanisms.

top_signals.title: Base targets June 25 mainnet launch for Beryl upgrade and new B20 token standard
top_signals.summary: Base is set to launch the Beryl upgrade on its mainnet on June 25. This update introduces the B20 native token standard and significantly reduces withdrawal delays to five days.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The B20 standard and reduced withdrawal delays on Base lower the friction for liquidity movement, enhancing the network's attractiveness for high-frequency dApps.

top_signals.title: CFTC, SEC request public comment to clarify definition of 'swaps' amid CME lawsuit
top_signals.summary: The CFTC and SEC are seeking public comments to clarify the definition of 'swaps' following a lawsuit from CME Group. The legal dispute centers on whether perpetual futures should be classified as futures contracts or swaps.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The classification of perpetuals as either swaps or futures will dictate the regulatory burden and licensing requirements for the next generation of DeFi derivatives platforms.

top_signals.title: Kalshi making early IPO talks with investment banks: report
top_signals.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi is reportedly in early discussions with investment banks regarding an initial public offering. This follows a massive $1 billion Series F funding round in May that valued the company at $22 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A potential Kalshi IPO at a $22B valuation creates a massive valuation benchmark for the prediction market sector, likely triggering a wave of venture capital into competing Web3 protocols.

top_signals.title: Morgan Stanley files amendments for ETH and SOL ETFs, revealing lowest fees in market
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley has filed amendments for its proposed Ethereum and Solana ETFs, signaling active progress with the SEC. The filings reveal a strategy to offer the lowest fees in the market to attract investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Morgan Stanley's aggressive fee-cutting strategy suggests that ETF success will be driven by a 'race to the bottom' on costs, squeezing margins for early entrants.

on_the_radar.title: Celsius’ Mashinsky gets permanent trading ban in CFTC settlement
on_the_radar.summary: Alex Mashinsky, the founder of Celsius, has reached a settlement with the CFTC resulting in a permanent trading ban. This legal action follows the collapse of the Celsius lending platform and subsequent allegations of fraud.

on_the_radar.title: Fidelity launches GENIUS-aligned money market fund for stablecoin issuers
on_the_radar.summary: Fidelity has launched a money market fund specifically designed for stablecoin issuers to manage their reserve assets. This move bridges traditional finance and Web3 by providing institutional-grade liquidity management for the stablecoin ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: WhiteBIT secures MiCA license in Austria ahead of July 1 EU deadline17m, WhiteBIT secures MiCA license in Austria ahead of July 1 EU deadlineThe Austrian authorization gives WhiteBIT access to the EU's unified crypto framework, which will require exchanges to hold MiCA licenses or stop serving clients after July 1.
on_the_radar.summary: WhiteBIT has obtained a MiCA license in Austria, ensuring its continued operation within the European Union. This move allows the exchange to comply with the unified crypto framework before the July 1 deadline.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin Miners Pivot to AI as Tokenized RWAs Surge and Ripple Expands Africa Push
on_the_radar.summary: A roundup of industry developments including Bitcoin miners diversifying into AI infrastructure and the growth of tokenized Real World Assets (RWAs). Additionally, Ripple is expanding its footprint in Africa while Sam Bankman-Fried faces legal setbacks.

on_the_radar.title: OSL Group Secures Australian Financial Services Licence, Strengthening Regulated Stablecoin and Payments Infrastructure in Australia
on_the_radar.summary: OSL Group has secured an Australian Financial Services Licence to expand its regulated operations. This move strengthens the company's infrastructure for stablecoin payments and trading within the Australian market.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum faces core development funding crisis, former contributor warns
on_the_radar.summary: A former Ethereum contributor has warned that the network's core development is facing a funding crisis. The concerns center on the sustainability of developer grants and the long-term financial support for critical infrastructure updates.

on_the_radar.title: Binance can serve Philippine traders under SEC framework, BlockShoals says1h, Binance can serve Philippine traders under SEC framework, BlockShoals saysThe exchange's Philippine return relies on an SEC sandbox arrangement that BlockShoals says permits trading access without a local VASP license.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance may be able to operate in the Philippines through an SEC sandbox framework. According to BlockShoals, this arrangement could allow the exchange to provide trading access without requiring a local VASP license.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum could face core development 'funding crisis' within nine months, says former EF contributor
on_the_radar.summary: Former Ethereum Foundation contributor VanEpps has warned of a potential funding crisis for Ethereum's core development. The crisis is expected to occur within three to nine months following the expiration of the Community Infrastructure Project (CIP).

linkedin_post:
Prediction markets are moving from the fringes of the internet to the balance sheets of the world's largest financial institutions. With Charles Schwab reportedly entering the space and Kalshi eyeing an IPO after a $1B Series F, we are seeing a fundamental shift in how information is priced and hedged.

This isn't just about betting on elections or indices; it's about the institutionalization of 'truth markets.' For Web3 founders, the opportunity lies in building the transparent, permissionless infrastructure that can support this demand at scale. Meanwhile, the ETF landscape is entering a fee war, with Morgan Stanley attempting to undercut the market to capture ETH and SOL flows.

As prediction markets go mainstream, will decentralized protocols be able to compete with the distribution power of TradFi giants, or will they become the backend plumbing for these new institutional products?
